acceptance:
1. Record all four role classes and all §11.6.2 semantic fields; exact component/role/protocol/version identity and predeclared comparator/value hypothesis are required at evaluation readiness.
2. JEV receives no default classification; role outcomes are independent and cannot grant admission to another role or confuse research verdicts.
3. Initial evaluation has no productive authority; requested authority is distinct from granted authority. Strategy/Evidence cannot claim evaluation readiness without its applicable accepted IMP-27/§8.7 gate; execution/governance requires separate authority validation before real actions.
4. Preserve cost/latency/burden and evidence unknowns, overlap assessment, reproducibility and removal/rollback path. Engineering value cannot be labeled procurement edge; no qualifying role means no integration.
5. Tests cover incomplete protocol, absent evidence/gates, per-role separation, no automatic authority/default JEV role and immutable prior outcomes/versions. Framework tests close neither factual DEP-28 nor admission of any component.
6. Produce complete §20.2.8 ST_RECEIPT with honest tests/evidence, scope/version, failures and unresolved facts; preserve accepted prerequisite hashes and prove no writes outside allowed_paths.

Unknown factual input is an audit finding with owner/retrieval action, not a new architectural decision. A necessary edit outside allowed_paths returns a bounded technical scope finding to Command; do not silently broaden scope.
